name: Bread (quick and easy)
recipe: 1. Mix all of the sieved bread flour, sieved white flour and yeast in a mixing bowl
2a. Slowly add the water bit by bit
2b. Add small amuounts of the butter
3. After 10 minutes of kneading add the salt and knead it into the dough
4. Place the dough into a loafing tin, cover with some fabric and leave for 35 minutes
5. Preheat the oven to 220 degrees celcius
6. Once the dough has risen place in the middle of the oven for 25 minutes
7. Once baked remove the bread from the oven, remove it from the tin and leave to rest for 10 minutes
